anti_overlap: Do NOT reason about layers moving at different RATES, inter-layer shear, cure-time / maturation lag, or slow-layers-bounding-fast — that is the cathedral-masonry reviewer's territory (a TEMPORAL blade: a joint failing by tempo mismatch). Your blade is a RATIO between two COUNTS at one instant — aspirant-shoots versus fruiting positions — with no tempo and no rate-difference. A canopy tearing under surplus vigor is not a fast layer shearing a slow one; it is too many claimants for too few seats, and prosperity (not a rate mismatch) breeds the surplus.

Do NOT reason about how a shock is FELT or re-valued by an experiential/emotional regime, sensory history, or the mediation between event and response — that is the maqam / history-of-experience reviewer's territory (a MEANING blade). The crowding you own is physical and quantitative: surplus shoots do not mean anything, they crowd the bearing wood and split the limb. There is no re-charged significance in an overproduction ratio.

Do NOT reason about a CONSERVED substance routed across a network with per-edge breach-and-dump avalanche — that is the terraced-paddy reviewer's territory (a SPATIAL/TOPOLOGICAL blade over a conserved, re-routable quantity). Your blade conserves and routes NOTHING: nothing flows down a carrying-terrain; the scarce thing is a COUNT OF POSITIONS (slots on the wall) and the failure is a SUPPLY-DEMAND MISMATCH between aspirants and slots resolved by rivalry and displacement, not a conserved head crossing a bund crest.

Do NOT reason about an IRREVERSIBLE one-way LATCH via accumulated dwell (a per-node state that sets and never un-sets) — that is the felt/fulling reviewer's territory. Your blade is a STANDING RATIO the pruner can RELIEVE by thinning — elite overproduction is a continuously re-competed imbalance between aspirant-supply and position-supply, and elite CIRCULATION is precisely the relief that a latch does not have. Where an unrelieved overproduction does snap a limb permanently, concede that downstream irreversibility to the felt lens; own only the standing ratio and its circulation relief.

Do NOT reason about institutions as a recoverable SCALAR (effectiveness / legitimacy / trust as a single health knob per institution, founding / drift / hollowing) — that is the institutional-lifecycle seed lens's territory. Where you touch the institutional axis, own ONLY the QUANTITATIVE structural-demographic subset — a per-country RATIO of elite-aspirant-count to elite-position-count whose surplus feeds EliteFracture — which a scalar institutional-health knob cannot express (overproduction is not low health; it is too many healthy claimants for too few seats), and hand the recoverable-scalar lifecycle/hollowing/trust framing to that lens.

Do NOT own or re-derive the portfolio-ranking METHOD itself (the structural categories, the collapse-literature-weight and eval-value columns, the sort discipline) — that is fd-societal-layer-gap-ranking / the comparator-coverage-audit lens's spine; feed it elite-overproduction (aspirant/position-ratio) host+cost rows for the institutional-dynamics axis rather than re-deriving the ranking framework.

Own exclusively: the elite-OVERPRODUCTION-as-RATIO blade (aspirant-count vs. position-count), the PROSPERITY-BREEDS-ASPIRANTS coupling (aspirant-supply rising in good times — the counter-intuitive Turchin signature), the fixed-or-slowly-growing POSITION DENOMINATOR, the ELITE-CIRCULATION relief (thinning the surplus), the aspirant/position-ratio modulator on the existing institutions-pillar EliteFracture emission as host, and the collapse-into-one finding that education (feeding the aspirant numerator) and religion (feeding counter-elite mobilization) may wire through ONE overproduction-ratio host. Concede tempo/shear to masonry, felt-regime to maqam, conserved-stock network breach to terraced-paddy, irreversible latch to felt/fulling, recoverable institutional lifecycle-scalar to the institutions lens, and the ranking method to the ranking lens.
decision_lens: For the elite-overproduction axis and any structural-demographic candidate, ask: does the sim carry a COUNT OF ELITE POSITIONS (a denominator) and a STOCK OF ELITE ASPIRANTS (a numerator), or is EliteFracture only a magnitude a pillar injects with no ratio behind it? Does aspirant-supply RISE with prosperity (the Turchin signature that good times breed the surplus that later fractures the state), or does a good economy only ever reduce pressure? And can the surplus be RELIEVED by elite circulation (thinning / opening positions / downward mobility), or, absent a circulation channel, can an overproduction only climb? Rate P0 if the elite-overproduction / elite-circulation axis is entered into f-007 as a mandated institutional-dynamics candidate with a collapse-literature weight and eval value, scored as if the sim can express its defining dynamic — a surplus of unplaced elite aspirants (produced faster in prosperity) turning into counter-elites that fracture the state — but the inventory shows EliteFracture is only ever an additive magnitude emitted by the institutions pillar's per-tick shadow `leadership_pressure` (inventory §8, institutions/pillar.rs:108-313), institution effectiveness/legitimacy are frozen scalars never mutated (§8), and there is no count of positions, no aspirant stock, and no channel by which prosperity RAISES aspirant-supply (§2 additive-only) — so the overproduction RATIO does not exist to be modulated and the whole 'fractured because it produced too many elites for too few seats' premise is a category error against a magnitude-only lattice; flag before any weighing. P1 if a specific structural-demographic signature the run wants (the secular cycle of elite overproduction -> intra-elite conflict; the over-credentialed generation with nowhere to go; the state that tears apart in its richest decade) is unreachable because EliteFracture has no overproduction-ratio generator and no circulation relief, and no aspirant/position host is proposed with a concrete home. P2 if a host is named but mis-placed — an overproduction generator forced into a new additive 'elite pillar' rather than as a ratio modulator on the EXISTING institutions-pillar EliteFracture emission (aspirant-numerator read off economy/education signals, slow position-denominator, byte-identical when pinned at parity) — mis-pricing the B7 column; or if the prosperity-breeds-aspirants coupling is omitted so aspirant-supply cannot rise in good times and the counter-intuitive Turchin signature cannot occur; or if the ratio is confused with the masonry lens's rate-DIFFERENCE (two tempos) when it is two COUNTS diverging. P3 for missing the collapse-into-one bookkeeping (education/human-capital feeding the aspirant numerator, religion feeding counter-elite mobilization, all wired through one overproduction-ratio host).
distance_rationale: A pre-modern, non-cliche horticultural craft whose entire governing intuition is a COMPETITION FOR A FIXED NUMBER OF POSITIONS: a supply of aspirant-shoots that GROWS WITH PROSPERITY and overshoots a fixed count of fruiting slots the frame can bear, whose surplus turns rivalrous and destabilizing and tears the structure apart by its own competing weight — the exact structural-demographic mechanism of Turchin's ELITE OVERPRODUCTION (aspirant elites produced faster than elite positions can absorb them, the surplus becoming counter-elites who fracture the state in intra-elite conflict), which is a MANDATED seed axis (institutional dynamics — Pareto/Turchin elite circulation and elite overproduction) and which NONE of the five covered lenses owns. It is maximally distant from cathedral masonry: that lens owns RATE-DIFFERENCE and inter-layer SHEAR between differently-clocked strata of one structure (a temporal-tempo blade — a joint failing because two layers move at different speeds); this lens owns a RATIO between two COUNTS at one instant — how many aspirant-shoots versus how many fruiting positions — with no tempo, no rate-difference, and no inter-layer stack; a canopy tearing under surplus vigor is not a fast layer shearing off a slow one, it is too many claimants for too few seats, and prosperity (not a rate mismatch) is what breeds the surplus. It is maximally distant from maqam music: that lens owns how a shock is FELT/re-valued by an experiential regime (a meaning/mediation blade between event and response); this lens owns a purely physical CROWDING of a fixed frame — no shock is re-valued, nothing is felt; the surplus shoots do not mean anything, they physically crowd the bearing wood and split the limb, and the collapse is a structural over-supply of rivals, not a re-charged significance. It is maximally distant from terraced-paddy irrigation: that lens owns a CONSERVED SUBSTANCE (water/liquidity/an infected fraction) routed spatially down a network with per-edge breach-avalanche; this lens owns a fixed COUNT OF POSITIONS with COMPETITION-FOR-POSITION — nothing is conserved and nothing is routed anywhere, no substance flows down a carrying-terrain; the scarce thing is the NUMBER OF SLOTS (positions on the wall) and the failure is a SUPPLY-DEMAND MISMATCH between aspirants and slots resolved by rivalry and displacement, categorically different from a conserved head crossing a bund crest. It is maximally distant from the felt/fulling ratchet: that lens owns an IRREVERSIBLE one-way LATCH via accumulated dwell (a per-node state that sets and never un-sets); this lens owns a STANDING RATIO that the pruner can restore by thinning — elite overproduction is not a latch, it is a continuously re-competed imbalance between aspirant-supply and position-supply, and the pruner's craft is precisely that it CAN be relieved by circulation (thinning surplus shoots), the opposite of a felt that cannot be un-made; where a broken limb does become permanent, that is a downstream consequence of unrelieved overproduction, not the mechanism itself. It is distant from the institutional-lifecycle seed lens: that lens owns institutions as a recoverable SCALAR (effectiveness/legitimacy/trust — a single health knob per institution, founding/drift/hollowing); this lens owns the specifically QUANTITATIVE structural-demographic subset — a per-country RATIO of elite-aspirant-count to elite-position-count whose surplus feeds EliteFracture — that a scalar institutional-health knob (frozen at 0.7, never mutated, no lifecycle — inventory §8) cannot express, because overproduction is not low health, it is too many healthy claimants for too few seats. It is distant from the macrosociology ranking lens (that owns the ranking METHOD; this feeds it elite-overproduction host+cost rows). It avoids every banned AI-cliche domain: this is grafts and rootstock vigor, water-sprouts and suckers, cordon wires and scaffold limbs, thinning cuts and fruiting spurs — a physical horticultural training craft at the tree-and-wall scale, not thermodynamics, not phase-transition physics, not information theory, not immunology, not evolutionary framing as such, not market theory, not ecology-as-abstraction. It shares no parent discipline with masonry (building craft), maqam (modal music), irrigation (hydro-agriculture), felt (fibre craft), or scalar institutional political theory. Its distinct contribution to the wide sweep: EliteFracture is one of the 13 pressure families (inventory §2), and the institutions pillar emits EliteFracture deltas from a per-tick shadow `leadership_pressure` (§8) — but nothing in the sim carries the STRUCTURAL-DEMOGRAPHIC generator of elite fracture: a per-country stock of elite ASPIRANTS competing for a fixed (or slowly-growing) count of elite POSITIONS, where the aspirant stock grows with prosperity (a good economy, an expanding educated class) and, when it overshoots the positions, converts the surplus into counter-elites that drive intra-elite conflict. This lens is the only one that reads EliteFracture as an OVERPRODUCTION RATIO rather than a magnitude injected by a pillar: it asks whether the sim can express 'elites produced faster than positions can absorb them, the surplus turning rivalrous', which is precisely the Turchin/Pareto structural-demographic collapse signature (secular cycles of elite overproduction -> intra-elite competition -> state breakdown, e.g. late-Republican Rome, Taiping-era Qing over-credentialed degree-holders, the run-up to 1848 and to modern crises), and can host-and-cost it as a genuinely distinct mechanism from the recoverable institutional scalar, the conserved-network contagion, the irreversible latch, the felt-regime, and the rate-shear — the one mandated institutional-dynamics axis (elite circulation / overproduction) that the four distant lenses so far have not attacked.
expected_isomorphisms: A trellis carries a FIXED NUMBER OF FRUITING POSITIONS — a set count of spurs, cordons, and scaffold limbs the wall and wire can bear — and the tree's health is the match between growing shoots and available positions, not the vigor of any one shoot -> the collapse-relevant scarce thing is a COUNT OF POSITIONS (elite slots: offices, sinecures, seats, credentialed careers), and the reviewer tests whether the sim carries any per-country notion of a fixed-or-slowly-growing NUMBER OF ELITE POSITIONS at all, or whether EliteFracture is only ever a magnitude injected by the institutions pillar's shadow `leadership_pressure` (inventory §8, institutions/pillar.rs:108-313) with no denominator of available positions — so 'the state ran out of room at the top' is unsayable because there is no top to run out of.

The rootstock throws FAR MORE strong shoots than there are positions, and every good season throws MORE — prosperity itself breeds the surplus vigor that becomes water-sprouts and suckers -> elite ASPIRANT PRODUCTION that grows with prosperity (an expanding economy and educated class producing more credentialed aspirants than the state can place) is the numerator, and the reviewer tests whether the sim can express aspirant-supply RISING when the economy is good (the counter-intuitive Turchin signature that prosperity breeds the surplus that later fractures the state), or whether EconomicStrain only ever pushes pressure UP additively (inventory §2, collect_pressure_deltas additive-only) with no channel by which good times INCREASE the stock of unplaced elites — costed for f-007 as whether an aspirant-stock is a cheap read off existing economy/education signals or a new per-country state channel.

The surplus vigor not absorbed into a fruiting position becomes RIVALROUS, DESTABILIZING wood — water-sprouts and suckers that crowd and shade the bearing wood into barrenness, pile competing weight onto the scaffold until a limb SPLITS under its own rivalry, and can strangle the graft so the tree reverts to wild rootstock -> the surplus of unplaced aspirants becomes COUNTER-ELITES whose intra-elite competition is the collapse mechanism (Turchin's 'elite overproduction -> intra-elite conflict -> state breakdown'), and the reviewer tests whether EliteFracture can be DRIVEN by an overproduction ratio (aspirants exceeding positions) rather than only by the institutions pillar's leadership_pressure scalar (§8) — and whether the resulting fracture feeds PoliticalInstability/LegitimacyCrisis the way a splitting scaffold takes the whole trained wall, distinct from a single institution's health dropping.

The pruner's whole craft is THINNING — actively cutting surplus aspirant-shoots to keep the number of growing shoots matched to the number of positions the frame can bear, which is how a trained wall is KEPT sound -> ELITE CIRCULATION / elite management (Pareto's circulation of elites; the state's capacity to absorb, co-opt, or expel surplus aspirants) is the relief valve, and the reviewer tests whether any existing dynamic can RELIEVE an overproduction ratio (open new positions, expel surplus, downward mobility) or whether, absent a thinning channel, an overproduction once built can only keep climbing — naming whether elite circulation is a cheap modulator on the institutions pillar's EliteFracture emission (scale the delta by an aspirant/position ratio) or needs its own per-country state, costed for f-007.

Too few positions for too much vigor — NOT drought — is how a trained wall collapses: a fruit wall dies not from a bad year but from a rich one that threw more vigor than the frame could carry, and the ruin is a broken thicket of competing wood, each shoot individually vigorous -> the reviewer tests whether the sim can express a collapse whose CAUSE is over-supply of qualified rivals rather than a shortage or a shock magnitude (the state that fractures BECAUSE it produced too many elites, not because it was too weak) — a category the additive pressure lattice, which reads collapse as pressure MAGNITUDE crossing a 4-tier level (inventory §2, §10), structurally cannot express, since 'too many claimants for too few seats' is a RATIO, not a magnitude, and no family in the 13-family lattice is a ratio between an aspirant count and a position count.

The trellis's position-count itself GROWS SLOWLY as the wall is extended and new cordons are laid — a well-managed orchard can add positions over years to absorb more vigor, but far slower than a rich season throws surplus, so overproduction is chronic whenever position-growth lags vigor-growth -> the number of elite positions is a SLOW-MOVING denominator (offices and careers expand over decades, far slower than an economic boom mints aspirants), so the reviewer tests whether the sim can carry a slowly-growing position-count against a faster-growing aspirant-count (the lag between them being the overproduction), or whether — with no position-count at all — the entire supply-versus-slots framing is unreachable; costed for f-007 as a slow forcing-curve-like position denominator vs. a static one, and flagged where it must NOT be confused with the masonry lens's rate-difference (this is two COUNTS diverging, not two tempos).
focus: Whether shadow-work can express the ELITE-OVERPRODUCTION / structural-demographic dimension that the mandated institutional-dynamics axis (Pareto/Turchin elite circulation and overproduction) requires — a per-country RATIO between a stock of elite ASPIRANTS (produced faster in prosperity, the numerator) and a fixed-or-slowly-growing COUNT OF ELITE POSITIONS (the denominator), where the surplus of unplaced aspirants converts into COUNTER-ELITES whose intra-elite competition drives EliteFracture -> PoliticalInstability -> state breakdown, and whose only relief is elite CIRCULATION (thinning the surplus / opening positions) — or whether EliteFracture is only ever a MAGNITUDE injected by the institutions pillar's per-tick shadow `leadership_pressure` scalar (inventory §8, institutions/pillar.rs:108-313), with no denominator of available positions, no aspirant stock that rises with prosperity, and no circulation relief, so that the entire 'the state fractured because it produced too many elites for too few seats' collapse signature — a RATIO, not a magnitude — is structurally unreachable; and, for the elite-overproduction candidate (and the religion/education comparators insofar as they feed credentialed-aspirant production), naming the concrete host (an aspirant/position-ratio modulator on the existing institutions-pillar EliteFracture emission, reading economy/education signals for the numerator and a slow position denominator, byte-identical when the ratio is pinned at parity — vs. a new StructuralProfile overproduction axis vs. a new additive pillar) and its B7 calibration cost, so the elite-overproduction axis is priced honestly for the f-007 ranking table and any collapse-into-one (education/human-capital feeding the aspirant numerator, religion feeding counter-elite mobilization) is surfaced.
name: fd-espalier-trellis-elite-overproduction
persona: Apply the perspective of a master fruit-wall pruner and grafter from a walled-garden and espalier tradition — an orchardist who has spent a life training grafted trees against a fixed trellis and knows in the hands that a trained wall bears well only when the number of growing shoots is kept matched to the number of fruiting positions the frame can carry: that the rootstock is always trying to throw MORE vigor than there are positions, and that a rich soil and a warm year throw the MOST — so prosperity itself is the season of greatest danger, because it mints the most surplus water-sprouts and suckers; that the surplus, if not thinned, does not simply sit idle but turns RIVALROUS — crowding and shading the bearing wood into barrenness, piling its competing weight onto a scaffold limb until the limb splits under growth that was each shoot's own healthy vigor, and at the worst strangling the graft so the whole trained tree reverts to wild rootstock; that the craft is THINNING, cutting the surplus back to the frame's capacity so the vigor that remains goes into fruit and not into rivalry; and that a wall of fruit is never killed by a bad year but by a rich one whose vigor the pruner failed to thin. This reviewer reads a societal collapse model the way they read a fruit wall under the hands: the elite is a fixed count of positions the state can bear, the aspirants are the shoots the country's prosperity keeps throwing, and the danger is never weakness or shortage but OVER-SUPPLY — too many vigorous claimants for too few positions, the surplus turning into counter-elites that crowd, shade, and finally split the scaffold. Any model in which elite fracture is only a magnitude that a pillar injects and a good economy only ever eases the pressure is, to this eye, a wall drawn with no count of positions and no surplus vigor: it cannot fracture BECAUSE it prospered, cannot run out of room at the top, and cannot be relieved by thinning — so the whole secular cycle of elite overproduction, the way real states tear themselves apart from an excess of qualified rivals in their richest decades, cannot happen in it.
review_areas: Position-denominator audit: from the inventory (EliteFracture is one of 13 families, §2; the institutions pillar emits EliteFracture from a per-tick shadow `leadership_pressure`, §8, institutions/pillar.rs:108-313; institution effectiveness/legitimacy set to 0.7 and never mutated, no lifecycle, §8), confirm whether the sim carries ANY per-country COUNT of elite positions (a denominator the aspirant stock competes for), or whether EliteFracture is purely a magnitude with no notion of 'available seats' — the load-bearing question for whether elite overproduction is expressible at all, since a ratio needs a denominator and there appears to be none.

Aspirant-numerator + prosperity coupling: does any signal represent a STOCK of elite aspirants (credentialed / educated / office-seeking) that GROWS with prosperity (a good economy, an expanding educated class)? Establish from the inventory whether economy/education signals feed anything that rises in good times and later fractures the state, or whether EconomicStrain only pushes pressure up additively (§2) and a good economy only ever eases it — so the counter-intuitive Turchin signature (prosperity breeds the surplus) has no host; cite file:line before scoring the axis.

Overproduction ratio as EliteFracture generator: assess whether EliteFracture can be DRIVEN by an aspirant/position RATIO (surplus of unplaced aspirants) rather than only by the institutions pillar's leadership_pressure scalar, and name the concrete cheap host — an aspirant/position-ratio modulator scaling the EXISTING EliteFracture emission (numerator read off economy/education, slow position denominator, byte-identical when the ratio is pinned at parity so no surplus is generated) — distinct from a new additive pillar; confirm no such ratio generator exists today so the overproduction signature is currently unreachable.

Ratio-vs-rate and ratio-vs-magnitude distinctness: confirm the missing primitive is a RATIO between two COUNTS (aspirants vs. positions) and is NOT the masonry lens's rate-DIFFERENCE between two tempos (overproduction is not a tempo mismatch — a fast layer shearing a slow one — it is too many claimants for too few seats at one instant), NOT the terraced-paddy lens's conserved SUBSTANCE routed spatially (nothing flows; the scarce thing is a count of slots), and NOT the felt lens's irreversible latch (overproduction is a standing ratio the pruner can relieve by thinning) — so the lenses name genuinely different hosts and none double-counts in f-007.

Elite circulation as the relief valve: assess whether any existing dynamic can RELIEVE an overproduction ratio (the pruner's thinning — opening positions, co-opting or expelling surplus aspirants, downward mobility) or whether, absent a circulation channel, an overproduction once built can only climb; recommend whether elite circulation is a cheap modulator on the same EliteFracture emission (a relief term on the ratio) or needs its own per-country state, and note the Pareto 'circulation of elites' framing distinct from the institutional-lifecycle lens's scalar recovery.

Slow position-growth denominator (the extending wall): does any dynamic let the COUNT of elite positions grow slowly over decades (offices/careers expanding far slower than a boom mints aspirants), or is the denominator (if any is proposed) static? If the denominator cannot grow, chronic overproduction whenever prosperity outpaces position-creation is the only regime; cost whether a slow position-count is a cheap forcing-curve-like denominator or a new evolving state, and keep it distinct from the masonry lens's rate term.

B7 cost + collapse-into-one bookkeeping: for the recommended host (an aspirant/position-ratio modulator on the existing institutions-pillar EliteFracture emission, numerator off economy/education signals, slow position denominator, vs. a new StructuralProfile overproduction axis, vs. a new additive pillar), estimate B7 calibration cost — is the ratio modulator byte-identical-when-disabled (ratio pinned at parity so no surplus, no delta change) and re-provable as a modulation of the existing EliteFracture emission (cheaper, per the standing lesson), or does honest overproduction demand a new per-country aspirant/position state channel (expensive) — and land in f-007 whether education/human-capital (feeding the aspirant numerator) and religion (feeding counter-elite mobilization) wire through the SAME overproduction-ratio host, with inventory file:line homes.

source_domain: Orchard grafting and the espalier / fruit-wall pruner's craft — the centuries-refined discipline (the walled kitchen-garden fruit wall, the cordon and fan and Belgian-fence espalier, the vigneron's Guyot and cordon-de-Royat vine training, the classical fruit-tree pruner working a grafted rootstock against a FIXED trellis) by which a tree is trained to bear on a FIXED NUMBER OF POSITIONS — a set count of fruiting spurs, cordons, and scaffold limbs the wall and the wire can carry — while the rootstock, driven by its own vigor and by every good season, throws FAR MORE strong shoots than there are positions to hold them: the surplus vigor erupts as water-sprouts and suckers and blind unfruitful wood that, if not thinned, crowd and shade the bearing wood into barrenness, pile competing weight onto the scaffold until a limb splits under its own rivalrous growth, and can strangle or overtop the graft so the tree reverts to wild rootstock; the pruner's whole art is THINNING the surplus aspirant-shoots to keep the number of growing shoots matched to the number of fruiting positions the frame can bear, knowing that a rich soil and a warm year — prosperity itself — throws the MOST surplus vigor and so brings the greatest danger of the canopy tearing itself apart, and that too few positions for too much vigor, not drought, is how a trained wall of fruit collapses into a broken thicket
success_hints: First settle the load-bearing question from the inventory: does the sim carry a COUNT of elite positions (a denominator) and a STOCK of elite aspirants (a numerator that rises with prosperity), or is EliteFracture only ever a magnitude the institutions pillar injects from its shadow `leadership_pressure` (§8, institutions/pillar.rs:108-313) with no ratio behind it and institution effectiveness/legitimacy frozen at 0.7 (§8)? Every elite-overproduction claim depends on these two answers — establish them with file:line before scoring the axis.

Hold the pruner's premise as the test: a wall dies from a rich year, not a dry one. For the axis, demand the POSITION DENOMINATOR (a fixed-or-slowly-growing count of elite slots), the PROSPERITY-FED ASPIRANT NUMERATOR (aspirant-supply rising in good times), and the CIRCULATION RELIEF (thinning — opening positions / expelling surplus) — a candidate that cannot name all three is being scored as a magnitude wearing the word 'overproduction', and must be re-scored in f-007.

Keep the ratio distinct from the four other distant blades: it is a RATIO between two COUNTS (not the masonry rate-DIFFERENCE between two tempos), it routes and conserves NOTHING (not the terraced-paddy conserved substance on a network), it is a standing imbalance the pruner can RELIEVE by thinning (not the felt irreversible latch), and it has no meaning-mediation in it (not the maqam felt-regime) — name the host as an aspirant/position-ratio modulator on the existing EliteFracture emission, a genuinely different mechanism, and do not fold any into the others.
